title: Developer Proposal & Closing Kit
audience: Developers who need a consistent bridge from qualification to proposal and follow-up.
shortDescription: Qualify, propose, follow up, and close opportunities.
coreOutcome: Build a repeatable proposal and decision process.
problem: A proposal cannot repair weak qualification or an unclear buying process.
situation: Proposals take too long to prepare and then disappear into open-ended follow-up.
commonFailure: Sending a document before scope, fit, stakeholders, and decision timing are understood creates avoidable ambiguity.
methodology: Tie qualification, scope, proposal, decision criteria, and follow-up into one controlled process.
capabilities: Move from qualification to a bounded proposal
Follow up with a defined next action
whoItsNotFor: Anyone expecting unfinalized templates or scripts to be promised today

seo.title: Developer Proposal & Closing Kit | Prospect Foundry
seo.description: A structured system for qualifying, proposing, following up, and closing development work.
